results.name: mobile Open replays and credits its offline basket exactly once, then permits a ranked restart
Open waits for the recorded tick and multiple clicks cannot open a basket twice
an offline reload retains Open inputs; reconnect saves them and another device recovers the score
context clicks while paused or reading do not enqueue another gameplay action

limitations: Disposable PostgreSQL migrations 001–011, fixture Auth/HTTP/DOM and accelerated elapsed run time; no production write.
Real client/game input handlers and validateReplay/hf_replay_commit; no player position, reward or encounter edits.
Browser hit testing and physical touch hardware are separate checks.
